DESCRIPTION_COMMENTER_COMMENT_NOTIFICATI: Sent when a commenter has a reply to their comment.
DESCRIPTION_COMMENTER_VERIFY_POST: Sent when a commenter needs to verify their comment.
DESCRIPTION_COMMENTER_VERIFY_VOTE: Sent when a commenter needs to verify a vote.
DESCRIPTION_COMMENTER_WELCOME_FROM_COMME: Sent when a commenter creates their account by commenting for the first time.
DESCRIPTION_COMMENTER_WELCOME_FROM_VOTE: Sent when a comment creates their account by voting.
DESCRIPTION_POLL_VOTE_NOTIFICATION: Sent once a day to a poll creator when their poll got new responses.
NAME_TENANT_COMMENT_NOTIFICATION: New Comment Notification (For Admins and Moderators)
DESCRIPTION_TENANT_COMMENT_NOTIFICATION: Sent to administrators and moderators when new comments have arrived in the last hour.
DESCRIPTION_TENANT_USER_REMOVED_FROM_TEN: Sent to notify a user when they are removed from the tenant.
DESCRIPTION_SUBSCRIBED_PAGE_NOTIFICATION: Sent to notify a user of new comments on pages they've subscribed on.
DESCRIPTION_SITE_MEMBER_WELCOME: Sent when a new member signs up for a membership site.
DESCRIPTION_BADGE_AWARD: Sent when a user earns a new badge.
